title: 1950 AHSME Problem 12
statement: As the number of sides of a polygon increases from \(3\) to \(n,\) the sum of the exterior angles formed by extending each side in succession:

solutions.text:
Traversing the polygon and turning through each exterior angle makes one complete turn. Hence the sum is always \(360^\circ,\) independent of the number of sides.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Imagine walking once around the boundary of the polygon
The exterior angles record one complete turn
